studies.title: The cat
studies.caption: A cat watches from beside a grain store. Settled farming brought small predators and stored food into a lasting relationship with people.
studies.prompt: Low full-body profile of a slender short-haired sandy tabby domestic cat sitting alert beside plain woven grain baskets and a mudbrick wall, early Near Eastern village. Natural vertical pupils and paws, tail curling on ground, no collar, modern breed face or humans.
